title: Saudi Arabia: summer midday work ban
text: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development bans outdoor work under the sun during the hottest part of the day in summer, generally between 12:00 and 15:00 from mid June to mid September each year, with the exact dates set by ministerial decision annually. Employers must reschedule work to cooler hours and provide shade and water. This is a national rule, separate from Qatar's, and Harara does not compute against it; the exact decision text is not held in Harara's rule store.
source: Saudi Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD), summer midday work ban (annual ministerial decision)
